# fabric_poa (Resource)

Runs a FABRIC perform-operational-action request against a sliver. This is an action resource: replacing it re-runs the operation, and delete is non-reversible/no-op.

~> **Note:** Changing any request argument forces this resource to be replaced and re-runs the operation.

This is an action resource. It has no in-place update: changing any request
argument (`sliver_id`, `operation`, `node_set`, `bdf`, `vcpu_cpu_map`, `keys`,
or `triggers`) replaces the resource and re-runs the operation. Deleting the
resource only removes it from state; it does not undo the operation on the
sliver.

## Example Usage

### Reboot a sliver

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    fabric = {
      source  = "Testbed-IAC/fabric"
      version = "~> 0.1"
    }
  }
}

variable "fabric_token" {
  description = "FABRIC ID token (JWT). Set via TF_VAR_fabric_token. Do not commit."
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
}

variable "target_sliver_id" {
  description = "FABRIC sliver UUID to run the operational action against."
  type        = string
}

provider "fabric" {
  token = var.fabric_token
}

# Reboot a provisioned node sliver. Replacing this resource (changing sliver_id,
# operation, or triggers) re-runs the reboot; deleting it only forgets state.
resource "fabric_poa" "reboot" {
  sliver_id = var.target_sliver_id
  operation = "reboot"
}
```

### Pin vCPUs to host CPUs

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    fabric = {
      source  = "Testbed-IAC/fabric"
      version = "~> 0.1"
    }
  }
}

variable "fabric_token" {
  description = "FABRIC ID token (JWT). Set via TF_VAR_fabric_token. Do not commit."
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
}

variable "target_sliver_id" {
  description = "FABRIC sliver UUID to run the operational action against."
  type        = string
}

provider "fabric" {
  token = var.fabric_token
}

# Pin guest vCPUs to host CPUs. vcpu_cpu_map applies to the cpupin and numatune
# operations.
resource "fabric_poa" "cpu_pin" {
  sliver_id = var.target_sliver_id
  operation = "cpupin"

  vcpu_cpu_map = [
    {
      vcpu = "0"
      cpu  = "2"
    },
    {
      vcpu = "1"
      cpu  = "3"
    },
  ]
}
```

### Add an SSH key

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    fabric = {
      source  = "Testbed-IAC/fabric"
      version = "~> 0.1"
    }
  }
}

variable "fabric_token" {
  description = "FABRIC ID token (JWT). Set via TF_VAR_fabric_token. Do not commit."
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
}

variable "target_sliver_id" {
  description = "FABRIC sliver UUID to run the operational action against."
  type        = string
}

variable "ssh_public_key" {
  description = "SSH public key to add to the target sliver."
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
}

provider "fabric" {
  token = var.fabric_token
}

# Add an SSH key to a running sliver. The triggers map records the intent so a
# deliberate change re-runs the action; the same keys also apply to removekey.
resource "fabric_poa" "add_key" {
  sliver_id = var.target_sliver_id
  operation = "addkey"

  keys = [
    {
      key     = var.ssh_public_key
      comment = "research-ops-2026"
    },
  ]

  triggers = {
    rotation_batch = "2026-06-research-ops"
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `operation` (String) POA operation to run. Supported values are:

- `cpuinfo`
- `numainfo`
- `cpupin`
- `numatune`
- `reboot`
- `addkey`
- `removekey`
- `rescan`

~> **Note:** Changing this value replaces the action resource and re-runs the operation.
- `sliver_id` (String) Sliver identifier to run the POA against.

~> **Note:** Changing this value replaces the action resource and re-runs the operation.

### Optional

- `bdf` (List of String) Optional PCI bus-device-function list for operations that accept device targets.

~> **Note:** Changing this value replaces the action resource and re-runs the operation.
- `keys` (Attributes List, Sensitive) Optional SSH keys for `addkey` and `removekey` operations. These values are masked in plan output and state.

~> **Note:** Changing this value replaces the action resource and re-runs the operation. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--keys))
- `node_set` (List of String) Optional node set for operations that accept node targets.

~> **Note:** Changing this value replaces the action resource and re-runs the operation.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))
- `triggers` (Map of String) Arbitrary trigger values.

~> **Note:** Changing this map replaces the action resource and re-runs the POA.
- `vcpu_cpu_map` (Attributes List) Optional vCPU to CPU pinning map for `cpupin` and `numatune` operations.

~> **Note:** Changing this value replaces the action resource and re-runs the operation. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vcpu_cpu_map))

### Read-Only

- `error` (String) POA error text assigned by FABRIC when the operation fails.
- `id` (String) POA identifier assigned by FABRIC after the operation is created.
- `info` (String) POA info payload encoded as JSON when returned by FABRIC.
- `poa_id` (String) FABRIC POA identifier assigned by FABRIC after the operation is created.
- `state` (String) Terminal or current POA state assigned by FABRIC.

<a id="nestedatt--keys"></a>
### Nested Schema for `keys`

Required:

- `comment` (String) SSH key comment associated with the key.
- `key` (String, Sensitive) SSH public key content. This value is masked in plan output and state.


<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Read operations occur during any refresh or planning operation when refresh is enabled.


<a id="nestedatt--vcpu_cpu_map"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vcpu_cpu_map`

Required:

- `cpu` (String) Host CPU identifier to pin the vCPU to.
- `vcpu` (String) Guest vCPU identifier to pin.
